item.title: Russia poisoned Alexei Navalny with dart frog toxin, European nations say
item.description: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with a rare and lethal toxin found in the skin of poison dart frogs, five European countries said Saturday.

item.title: Could this be LeBron James' last season?
item.description: LeBron James still hasn't decided whether his unprecedented 23rd NBA season will be his last.

item.title: Baby food recalled for 'possible health risk' in dozens of states, including Ohio
item.description: Some baby food products that were distributed across the country are being recalled for a potential health risk, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration announced.

item.title: Florida man doing backyard target practice shoots neighbor's horse, sheriff's office says
item.description: The Martin County Sheriff's Office said a man has been charged after misfires during target practice injured a neighbor's horse on Saturday.

item.title: 1 in custody after shooting at Willoughby motel
item.description: A 20-year-old man was taken into custody by Willoughby police after a shooting at a motel Saturday night.

item.title: Former UFC champion released on parole after shooting at 4-year-old son’s alleged abuser: Report
item.description: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez has been released on parole after serving time in prison for an attempted murder conviction stemming from a 2022 shooting involving a man accused of sexually abusing his young son, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Pro Football Hall of Fame selling juicer inspired by Super Bowl ad
item.description: Do you think the Pro Football Hall of Fame looks like a juicer? Actor Matthew McConaughey thinks so, and the hall of fame is fully embracing the idea with a new item added to its online shop.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins the Daytona 500 in car owned by Michael Jordan
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: Dense fog advisory issued across Northeast Ohio
item.description: Anyone who is going to be out and about Sunday evening will need a heavy jacket. Temperatures will drop through the 40s and into the 30s Sunday evening.

item.title: Willoughby Hills officials monitoring Chagrin River for ice jams: 'Very dangerous situation'
item.description: With warmer temperatures arriving in Northeast Ohio, officials in Willoughby Hills are closely monitoring the Chagrin River.
